# PictureProfile

Namespace `Nfty.Core.Imaging` in assembly `Nfty.Core`.

```csharp
public sealed class PictureProfile
```

A picture's embedded ICC profile, read by nfty's own reader, and the one conversion of it to sRGB both front-ends use.

## Remarks

**Why convert.** nfty stores and publishes pixels with no profile, and everything downstream (marketplaces, browsers, game engines) reads untagged pixels as sRGB. A picture drawn in Display P3 or Adobe RGB, imported byte for byte, therefore looks duller and shifted everywhere it travels. Converting at import makes the stored pixels mean what the artist saw.

**Never parsed by ImageSharp**: the raw profile is lifted out of the file's own container by `IccProfileBytes` and read by `IccRgbProfile` (profile at most 1 MB, 100 tags, 4096 curve entries).

**The conversion**, per pixel: each channel through its tone curve to linear (a 256-entry table per channel), the profile's colorant matrix to PCS XYZ (D50), Bradford D50 to D65, the IEC 61966-2-1 XYZ-to-linear-sRGB matrix, clamp to 0..1, then the sRGB transfer function back to 8 bits by searching a table of the 255 midpoints between codes (round to nearest, ties to the upper code). All in `Double`, no SIMD, nothing culture-dependent, so the same picture converts to the same bytes on every machine. Alpha is untouched. Out-of-gamut colors clip per channel: the simple, predictable answer, and what a "relative colorimetric" convert does.

**Order on a value-map layer**: converted FIRST, then [`ImageImport.ToValueMap()`](Nfty.Core.Editing.ImageImport.md#m-tovaluemap-sixlabors-imagesharp-image-sixlabors-images-032d59) takes its lightness, so a Dynamic/Static layer's grays are the lightness of the colors the artist saw.

public void ConvertToSrgb(Image<Rgba32> image);

Converts a decoded picture's pixels from this profile to sRGB, in place. Alpha is untouched.

**Parameters**

- `image` (`Image<Rgba32>`) - The picture, decoded from the file this profile was read from.

**Exceptions**

- `InvalidOperationException` - The profile cannot be converted ([`PictureProfile.CanConvert`](Nfty.Core.Imaging.PictureProfile.md#p-canconvert) is false).
